candidates.exact_claim: For each quadratic-compatible linear map f:V→A there is a unique unital algebra map f̄:Cl(V,Q)→A with f̄∘i_Q=f.
candidates.why_warranted: The central assertion is a factorization with both a generating map and a quotient map; a small commutative diagram would expose the compatibility condition and the uniqueness target.
candidates.specific_content: Draw V→Cl(V,Q) labeled i_Q and V→A labeled f, with Cl(V,Q)→A labeled f̄; indicate f̄∘i_Q=f and the uniqueness of f̄. Avoid including the tensor algebra intermediate unless a second diagram makes the proof factorization through T_k(V) clear.
candidates.evidence_note: The frozen statement and proof state the factorization and compatibility equations explicitly; the ItemBody contains no diagram.

candidates.exact_claim: The pairing φ_{n,t}(x,y) is the coefficient δ^c of the identity t→t after reflecting x and capping with y, and φ(x·a,y)=φ(x,y·a*).
candidates.why_warranted: The definition and invariance proof depend on reflection reversing stacking, closed-loop removal, and preservation of the exterior matching; one small schematic could make those operations and the adjointness identity easier to check.
candidates.specific_content: Show link states x,y:n→t, reflection x*:t→n, and the composite y∘x*:t→t with a representative closed loop labeled δ and the identity-through-line outcome. Add a second labeled composition comparison for (x∘a)*=a*∘x* and the equal coefficient-of-1_t identity; do not imply every composite yields a loop-only identity.
candidates.evidence_note: The exact reflection, cap, loop, and adjointness claims are in the frozen statement and proof; no diagram is currently present.

candidates.exact_claim: There are y,z:n→r with y∘z*=1_r; e=z*∘y is idempotent, A_r≅eA_ne, and W_{n,t}e≅W_{r,t}.
candidates.why_warranted: The truncation relies on paired diagram retractions and the resulting corner equivalence; a schematic could help readers track the direction of y,z, the identity composite, and the module isomorphism.
candidates.specific_content: Draw y,z:n→r with y∘z*=1_r, the induced idempotent e=z*∘y:n→n, and the mutually inverse module maps xe↦x∘z* and u↦u∘y. Label the corner algebra map a↦z*∘a∘y and its inverse b↦y∘b∘z*.
candidates.evidence_note: The retraction, idempotent, corner algebra isomorphism, and module maps are stated explicitly at the cited frozen source lines; no diagram is currently present.
